name: api_automation_playwright_ts
description: API automation framework using Playwright and TypeScript

scripts.zap:start: docker rm -f zap 2>nul & docker run -d --name zap -p 8080:8080 zaproxy/zap-stable zap.sh -daemon -host 0.0.0.0 -port 8080 -config api.disablekey=true -config api.addrs.addr.name=.* -config api.addrs.addr.regex=true
scripts.test:security: cross-env RUN_SECURITY_SCAN=true SECURITY_ARTIFACT_DIR=qa-artifacts/security/latest playwright test --grep @smoke --project=chromium && cross-env RUN_SECURITY_SCAN=true SECURITY_ARTIFACT_DIR=qa-artifacts/security/latest playwright test --grep @smoke --project=pim-ui --project=leave-ui --project=admin-ui
